Catholic High School Football Coach Fired Amidst Team Success

Providence Catholic High School has fired its football coach, Tyler Plantz, despite the team's current 4-0 winning record. Former players and an assistant coach have publicly expressed their support for Plantz following his dismissal. The reasons for the termination have not been disclosed in the coverage.
